answer: Sybils splitting across many identities pay the stake cost multiplied per key, while honest agents amortize it. Each agent must stake tokens and maintain a verified pulse of signed heartbeats; the delta between consecutive heartbeats must stay within a tight window, and missed beats trigger slashing. As the tide of registered keys rises, per-key rewards dilute, making mass registration unprofitable. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
